initial_configuration_assessment.method: Default plus 128 ConfigSpace draws, seed 20260727, evaluated on 64 evenly spaced training instances with quantile seed 0.
initial_configuration_assessment.replacement_rule: Replace the ACLib default when its screen rank is at most 15 of 129.
initial_configuration_assessment.selection_note: The default was not unusually strong, so the ordinary ACLib default is retained.

telemetry.acquisition: Expected Improvement and its RF moments retained from the exact current acquisition evaluation (with a one-prediction closed-form fallback)
telemetry.first_completion_event: Links the proposal fingerprint to its SMAC runhistory config ID and first completed target trial
telemetry.prediction: SMAC RF mean, variance, and standard deviation marginalized over all training instances at proposal time
telemetry.proposal_event: One durable event per unique configuration, captured before the configuration is yielded for evaluation
telemetry.tree_depths: get_depth() for every fitted SMAC RF tree
